objective: Reduce the AE overlap bridge directionality obligation by provisionally typing K_R(A -> E; B,O,M_R) as the Affect-to-Effect pre-squared directionality carrier.

formalization.name: Directional Relational Amplitude
formalization.role: Preserve represented Affect-to-Effect directionality before squared projection.
formalization.directionality_rule: K_R(A -> E) and K_R(E -> A) are not interchangeable unless explicit symmetry metadata is declared.

obligation_reduction.previous_obligation: Define directional relational amplitude K_R(A -> E) or equivalent directionality carrier.
remaining_obligations: Validate or refine K_R under concrete representation choices.
Define whether M_R is linear, nonlinear, or domain-selected.
Specify whether Affect and Effect occupy the same representation space or dual spaces.
Define probability normalization over mutually distinguishable candidate effects before probability language is permitted.

negative_constraints: K_R is not probability by default.
K_R does not identify raw Affect and Effect with quantum states.
K_R does not make symmetric squared overlap a full realization-process model.
